I've created a complete line chart visualization showing renewable energy consumption from 2015-2024. The visualization includes:

**Data**: Global renewable energy generation with three main sources:
- Solar: Grew 8x from 256 TWh (2015) to 2,131 TWh (2024)
- Wind: Nearly tripled from 840 TWh to 2,494 TWh
- Hydropower: Stable at ~4,000-4,400 TWh

**Visualization**: Interactive multi-line chart with:
- Three distinct colored lines (Solar: orange, Wind: blue, Hydropower: green)
- Time-based x-axis (2015-2024)
- Generation values in TWh on y-axis
- Interactive tooltips and legend
- Fully customizable styling

**Data Connections**: All data columns are linked to their corresponding visualization parameters, so the chart will automatically display the energy trends over the 10-year period.
